input.selectionId: opaque UUID from current available capability receipt

agent_extension_inventory_status.output: InventoryOperation; unknown ID => fixed Failure unknownRequest

ExtensionCapabilities.selectionId: UUID v4 when available; null when unavailable

frontendContract: Capability is refreshed, not permanently cached; environmentUnavailable may be temporary. Explicit ordinary program-list preparation then retry can initialize existing environment cache. Inventory itself never triggers that preparation.

A fresh nonreusable owner holds actual current Agent row/program/environment, cwd and active panel. A-B-A, close, source/program edit or refresh retires owner and requests exact cancel. UUID alone does not restore ownership.
Query is explicit, no auto-loop. State cancelling means requested, not exited. pendingCleanup retains exact status/cancel and blocks successor until actual settled result.
Only ready+settled snapshot is inventory; failed/cancelled/unknown is not an empty list. [] is valid only in full successful snapshot.
Standalone CLI config scope is not current session tools or readiness. Do not infer tools/skills from commands; preserve P39/P40/P41 gaps.
Official CLI may perform its own network/auth/cache work. Farfold does not scan config, inject its credentials or run an MCP server; no zero-side-effect claim.

selectionReceipt.storage: RAM only exact AgentRow, never serialized or hashed environment
selectionReceipt.expiry: selectionChanged; explicitly refresh capability, never automatic query retry
selectionReceipt.duplicateRequest: same requestId must have same agent/cwd/selectionId; existing request status/cancel does not recheck expired selection
